description: Use this when the user asks about grid capacity or time to power in one US ISO: demand, fuel mix, excess-power and constraint bands, queue.

iso.description: Alias for region_id — the ISO/RTO or balancing-authority code

market.description: Market NAME or metro slug instead of a grid code, e.g. "Ashburn", "northern-virginia", "dallas". Resolved to its ISO through the published DCPI market row before the brief is built; the answer carries a resolved_from block naming what it resolved to. Not an alias for region_id — "Ashburn" is not a grid code.

region.description: Alias for region_id — the ISO/RTO or balancing-authority code

region_id.description: Grid region (required): one of the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), an EIA balancing-authority code (e.g. SOCO, DUK, AZPS, TVA), or the PJM Dominion zone region_id="PJM-DOM" for Ashburn / Northern Virginia zone load from EIA-930: hourly and dated, but posted daily, so about 1.5-2.5 days old and not live. Real-time LMP for the zone is withheld for licence reasons (licence_withheld).
